verdict.rationale: IP India's own 'Forms & Official Fees' page publishes the statutory First Schedule as fee amounts by filing mode, with downloadable forms, rather than routing users to a contact form. This directly matches the story, but the evidence covers only the patents section and comes solely from first-party docs. Missing for 10: evidence of published fee amounts for trademarks/designs/GI transactions, detail on applicant-category (e.g. startup/small entity) fee tiers, independent or hands-on corroboration that the amounts are current and complete.
